flags.headline: Heat/hot water at 33.9% of complaints
flags.detail: 5,372 heat/hot water complaints out of 15,855 total. Heating season should be winding down — this suggests landlords cutting heat prematurely or chronic system failures.

flags.headline: Bronx: 33.1% of housing complaints (14% of population)
flags.detail: The Bronx accounts for 33.1% of all HPD complaints with only 14% of the city's population — a 2.4x overrepresentation.

flags.headline: 29 new vacate orders, 29 active
flags.detail: 29 buildings ordered vacated or repaired this week (avg: 26/week). Top reason: Fire Damage. BK leads with 9.

flags.headline: Top crash cause: Driver Inattention/Distraction
flags.detail: Accounts for 27.5% of this week's 342 crashes (94 incidents).

flags.headline: Shooting data: 0 incidents reported
flags.detail: NYPD restructured shooting datasets in Feb 2026 (now 3 separate datasets). Zero may reflect reporting lag rather than no incidents.
